name: Foveated Spatially Varying Lens Approximation
aliases: Tracked Spatially Varying Lens Phase Function Method
definition: A high-speed option to approximate spatially variant focus and aberration control by providing the correct lens function where the user is looking, rather than computing the full spatially variant solution.
summary: Foveated Spatially Varying Lens Approximation applies a temporally varying lens phase function at the tracked fovea to approximate spatially variant focus, providing smooth aberration correction without the sharp discontinuities of piece-wise methods.
